snippet.title: [RF ONLINE NEXT] Developer Commentary Episode 2: World, Art, and Sound
snippet.description:
The Ruthless Steel Sci-Fi MMORPG, RF ONLINE NEXT
👉Pre-register now: https://ntiny.link/RFONLINENEXT_sns_ww

Developer Commentary Episode 2: World, Art, and Sound
Hello, I'm Hong Kwangmin, General Producer of RF Online Next.
This video covers RF Online Next's world, art, and sound.
See for yourself how we set out to deliver RF Online Next's unique sci-fi feel to our players.
Pre-registration is currently underway, with plenty of rewards available for those who sign up.
Subscribe to our official channel and stay tuned for the next commentary video.
Your interest and support mean everything to us. Thank you!
